dataset: Bangladesh public health facilities — selected care facility types
selection: Active public records (is_private=Public and is_active=Yes) limited to listed care facility types. Administrative offices, training institutions, and private facilities are excluded.
reuse_note: Public registry access; no explicit redistribution license was identified in the registry page. Review DGHS terms before operational redistribution or production use.
coverage: Nationwide source snapshot across all eight divisions and 64 districts; registry names and status are a point-in-time snapshot, not a live directory.
important_note: Facility records do not confirm current availability, staffing, opening hours, service capacity, medicine stock, ambulance availability, distance, travel time, suitability, or emergency acceptance. Verify locally.
